{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the counts of -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
total_rows = len(data)
percentage_neg999 = (count_neg999 / total_rows) * 100

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Print results
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}")
print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"Percentage of -999 values: {percentage_neg999:.1f}%")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {duplicate_patients}")"}
